title: 2009 Prairie's north corner and tall stack brought down to the photograph
items: The Meyer house at 2009 Prairie is half a metre lower at its north corner. Its low top storey now stops where the old photograph shows the side walls ending, just over the paired window's hood.
The tall chimney on the north side no longer climbs past the top of the photograph. Its cap now stands where the picture puts it, about 16.3 m up.
